reason: Two facts found after registration and before any evaluation or training: (1) the VM's Ollama (0.34.1) refuses LoRA adapters ('LoRA adapters are no longer supported'), so a tuned adapter cannot be attached to the Ollama base; (2) Ollama at temperature 0 with a fixed seed was not deterministic on 1 of 3 repeated requests (parallel batching).

changes.serving_and_evaluation_engine: All four conditions (B0, B1, T0, T1) are run through ONE engine: llama.cpp's llama-server (the build in ~/gwaya-lite, used read-only), one slot, temperature 0, fixed seed, base = the Q4_K_M GGUF blob of Ollama's qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct (same weights the router serves). B uses no adapter; T uses the same server with --lora <adapter>.gguf (adapter converted with llama.cpp's convert_lora_to_gguf.py). This replaces 'Ollama native API' for B0/B1/T0/T1. Rejection SAMPLING for training data stays on Ollama (already running, registered conditions unchanged).
changes.determinism_control: the determinism check is repeated on llama-server (first 30 problems twice); if still not identical the report states the noise level and gives paired counts only
changes.serving_if_accepted: the tuned adapter is served by llama-server with --lora behind the producer shield (not by Ollama); Ollama keeps serving the base as the rollback

unchanged: gate and judging with ALL tests
evidence: adapter_is_applied mechanism verified beforehand on a 1.5B stand-in with a random LoRA: llama-server output changed with --lora and not without it (no quality claim from that probe)

addendum_prompt_cache.finding: llama-server with cache_prompt on (its default) gave 5 of 30 non-identical repeated requests at temperature 0, seed 7, one slot; with cache_prompt false it gave 0 of 12 (a different, smaller sample, so this is evidence not proof).
addendum_prompt_cache.rule: all B and T evaluation requests set cache_prompt=false; the full determinism check (30 problems twice) is re-run and reported with the result; the earlier partial run (cache on, 18 problems) is discarded and not used.
